archetypes.name: dyn-progress-pointer
archetypes.rationale: Verify run-pointer activation ordering, validation, and best-effort behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the bootstrap progress activation change in python/larch/state/bootstrap.py and its tests. Focus on whether the resolved run ID is used only after validate_run_id accepts it, whether progress activate remains best-effort, and whether the activation happens before Step 0 timing without changing resume behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
